name: TableScroll
description:
The scroll box around an AI table: horizontal scroll for wide tables, vertical scroll past
`maxRows` with the header stuck, and the scrolled-edge hairlines (R5.8). Keyboard
scrollable (R20.6).
signature: ({ label, maxRows, className, style, children, ...rest }: TableScrollProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the scrolling region.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Cap the height so long tables scroll inside themselves with a sticky header.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
